name: Vorn Skyseer
summary: At Camp Narache, Vorn Skyseer welcomes young tauren beginning their journeys. He lives among the tents on Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore and introduces newcomers to camp life.

sections.title: A Friendly Face at Camp Narache
sections.body: At Camp Narache, Vorn Skyseer greets young tauren beginning their rites of passage. They prepare to leave Red Cloud Mesa for the wider valleys of Mulgore, and his kind words and welcome help them settle into camp.

sections.title: A Detached Observer
sections.body: Vorn Skyseer leaves the camp's defense to its braves. He lives quietly and without hurry, watching over the plains of his homeland.

faq.answer: Vorn Skyseer is an elder resident of Camp Narache in Mulgore. He welcomes young tauren braves beginning their introductory rites at Red Cloud Mesa.

faq.q: Where can I find Vorn Skyseer?
faq.answer: You can find Vorn Skyseer resting outdoors among the tents of Camp Narache, atop Red Cloud Mesa in southwestern Mulgore.
Vorn receives the Bloodhoof Village Gift Voucher in Welcome! He greets its bearer and offers a small companion to join them on their adventures.

angles.text: As a young tauren on Red Cloud Mesa, you may find Vorn Skyseer among the first familiar, reassuring faces to greet you as you prepare for the wider life of Mulgore.
As a member of the Horde, you can see in Vorn the calm, steady nature of the plains tribes gathered under Cairne Bloodhoof's leadership to build a permanent home.
